job.title: Software Engineer, Data Tooling
job.pay_full: $153,120 – $196,750 a year starting base pay (San Mateo, CA headquarters), plus equity compensation and benefits

details.about: Roblox is a platform where tens of millions of people explore, create, play, learn and connect in 3D experiences built by its community of developers and creators. On the Data Tooling team, this software engineer makes well-scoped improvements to shared data tools and workflows with guidance from experienced engineers, helping people understand data health and ownership, find the right datasets and run data operations safely.
duties: Implement and improve components of shared tools for data quality, lineage, metadata, ownership, observability, lifecycle management and optimization
Turn signals such as freshness, quality results, lineage, usage and compute or storage cost into alerts, dashboards, recommendations or workflows
Write clear, maintainable, tested and documented code following established patterns
Learn production practices such as instrumentation, rollout, monitoring and investigating issues, working with experienced engineers on incidents
Help extend and test AI-assisted data workflows with established permissions, traceability, safety checks and human-approval patterns
Work with teammates and partner teams to clarify requirements and deliver reusable improvements
needs: 1–3 years of software engineering experience with a track record of high-quality production code
Software engineering fundamentals and experience in at least one general-purpose programming language
Familiarity with data (SQL, data pipelines or structured datasets), or an interest in developing those skills
A careful approach to implementation, testing, debugging and documentation
Willingness to learn unfamiliar systems with guidance and act on feedback
Clear communication and a collaborative approach
Sound judgment on when to ask for help or escalate
details.benefits: Starting base pay $153,120 – $196,750 a year for roles based at the San Mateo, CA headquarters; actual pay depends on background, training, experience, location, business needs and market demand. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and benefits.
notes: Office-based roles are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday
Roblox may not be able to employ candidates whose US work authorization relates to certain visa categories, or support future F-1 or H-1B sponsorship
